subject: Request: one-off sandbox renewal + POC runway grant for CoralHealth
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off sandbox renewal + POC runway grant for CoralHealth

Hi Karthik / Markus —

Quick ask: CoralHealth (Emma Liu) is at the point where the POC needs another 6 weeks to complete a scale test against electronic intake/triage flows. Their usage in the past 2 weeks spiked (attached usage CSV). They’re a strategic mid-market Healthcare prospect in the EU (regulated).

What I’m requesting from Deal Desk / Execs:
- One-time sandbox renewal of 45 days beyond the PLG 30-day limit (so total extra 45 days)
- $15,000 in complimentary platform credits allocated to the CRL-2028-07 POC to cover scaling tests and a limited data-residency staging run

Rationale / risk:
- This team is on a tight procurement timeline and will decide vendor by late Sep if the scale test succeeds.
- They’ve agreed to a pilot SOW and procurement pre-checks (see SOW attachment).
- If we decline, they indicated they’ll pause the POC and re-evaluate alternatives (likely higher friction).

Any non-standard terms will require legal signoff; Markus I’ve attached the SOW draft and the latest usage CSV. If this needs CRO-level signoff, can Aditya confirm?

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off sandbox renewal + POC runway grant for CoralHealth

Sofia —

Thanks for the context. A couple quick items we need before exec consideration:
1) Expected consumption profile for the extra 45 days (tokens / peak qps) — granular estimate please.
2) Win plan / commitment ask from the customer if we grant credits (e.g., pilot-to-paid timeline, ARR forecast, procurement milestones).
3) Legal: confirm there are no data-residency commitments that require Private deployment.

If you can paste the consumption estimate inline I’ll model the cost impact; if the ask stays in the <$20k one-off credits and we get a firm procurement close target, CRO sign-off is usually straightforward.

—Karthik
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off sandbox renewal + POC runway grant for CoralHealth

Hi — following up with the numbers below (pulled from the staging runs last week):

Estimated incremental consumption over 45 days (worst-case):
- Avg generated tokens/day: 1.8M tokens/day
- Peak burst: 6 concurrent sessions at 1.5 qps each for 1 hour/day
- Estimated total tokens for the 45-day window: ~81M tokens
- Platform cost estimate at expected routing/quantized config: ~$12,400

Win plan / commitment:
- Customer commits to a procurement review on 2028-09-22 and procurement can sign within 7 business days after a final SOW.
- If we provide the sandbox renewal + credits, CoralHealth will: (a) run a final integration test (b) deliver a written post-poc evaluation with a product recommendation and (c) name Redwood in their RFI shortlist (they confirmed verbally).

Legal/data residency:
- Emma confirmed data for staging will be pseudonymized; no regulated PHI will leave their EU VPC. They requested temporary extra retention in the sandbox for debugging (30 days) — Markus, flag if that triggers anything.

Attachments: CoralHealth_POC_SOW.pdf (SOW draft), coralhealth-usage-202808.csv (detailed runs).

Aditya — would appreciate a oneline if you’re comfortable with one-off $15k credit + 45-day sandbox renewal to hit procurement timeline.

—Sofia
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off sandbox renewal + POC runway grant for CoralHealth

Thanks team —

I’m approving a one-time, non-recurring grant: $15,000 in platform credits scoped to deal CRL-2028-07 and a 45-calendar-day sandbox renewal (from the PLG end date). Conditions:
1) Credits expire if account is not converted to a paid contract within 60 days after the extended window.
2) Legal (Markus) to confirm there are no outstanding compliance blockers — if any data-residency or retention changes are required we pause until resolved.
3) Sales to log the credit allocation and updated Win Plan in HubSpot (link in metadata) and include a clause in the SOW that the grant is one-off.

Sofia — please send a short confirmation email to Emma and procurement with these terms and copy legal. Karthik, I’ll rely on your cost modeling to confirm we’re within tolerance; flag if I need to re-open.

—Aditya
